policy: Only these plan-approved differences are permitted. Approval describes scope; it does not verify an implementation. Add concrete new API/update-envelope versions and acceptance evidence before marking replacement behavior verified.

exceptions.changedBehavior: Remove host Node runtime reporting/management, Node toolchain settings and agents set --node.
exceptions.replacement: The core is one native executable. Worker placement such as run --node is preserved; job containers may still run Node and VS Code uses its supplied Node runtime.
exceptions.acceptance: Reject removed management flags with an actionable explanation; preserve node placement; prove standalone core starts without host Node/npm.
exceptions.implementationNote: Native CLI rejects agents set --node; build metadata reports runtime rust and managed act only. Temporary-HOME isolation/CLI contracts and actual Linux static executable proof are recorded in progress. Complete four-target standalone acceptance remains open.

exceptions.changedBehavior: Replace JavaScript entry-point, npm tarball and Node runtime identity with native build/target/artifact digest and release-manifest identity.
exceptions.replacement: Version native update envelopes independently and check component/API/update compatibility. Map linux/amd64, linux/arm64, darwin/amd64, darwin/arm64 explicitly. Fresh clusters are required; no mixed Node/native interoperability is promised.
exceptions.acceptance: Define exact versioned wire/CLI metadata examples; reject wrong-target, corrupt and incompatible artifacts; verify per-target mirrored updates and recovery.
exceptions.implementationNote: Native release schemaVersion 1, protocol {api:1,agent:1,update:1}, four explicit target keys, buildId and independent archive/executable SHA-256 digests are implemented. /v2/agent/update uses verified manifest/manifestSha256 and same-controller artifact paths; publish accepts the manifest plus four native archives. Wrong-target/corruption/staging/SQLite rollback contract tests pass; real mixed-target rollout remains open.

exceptions.changedBehavior: Add platform/service and Docker VM capacity metadata for native macOS; introduce launchd lifecycle support.
exceptions.replacement: Preserve meanings of existing resource/config fields. Distinguish host pressure, execution VM limits and Docker readiness. Distinguish boot-start daemons from login-start agents.
exceptions.acceptance: Document exact additive fields and test API/CLI consumers; verify both Mac architectures, late Docker startup, VM limits and actual launchd lifecycle.
exceptions.implementationNote: Native worker platform/target/runtime, Docker executionCapacity and readiness metadata, and systemd/launchd rendering are implemented. Mac actual service/VM/tool lifecycle remains unverified; cross compilation does not close it.

exceptions.changedBehavior: Native development defaults use distinct data/config/cache/service names rather than opening v1 state.
exceptions.replacement: Use gridstator-v2 data/config/cache paths and gridstator-native-* service names during development, with explicit new-cluster credentials. Final stable defaults and fresh-cluster cutover remain documented release work.
exceptions.acceptance: Inspect default paths and service names; run in a temporary HOME/XDG environment and show existing v1 sentinel state remains untouched.
exceptions.implementationNote: Native data/config/cache use gridstator-v2 and services gridstator-native-*. CLI temporary-HOME/XDG sentinel tests passed; clean stable cutover/recovery rehearsal remains open.
